description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPITest for the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI. It tests various API endpoints such as getOne, getAll, create, update, delete, and their validation rules. The tests mock dependencies like employee service, leave entitlement service, leave period service, and validate API responses and request validation logic.
